name: course-builder
description: Reusable Claude Code plugin that turns a module.spec.yaml into a full course-module artifact bundle by orchestrating 12 subagents, 3 skills and 2 PreToolUse hooks via the /course-builder:build-module command. Modes: repo-bugs (student repo with planted verified bugs), projeto-pitch, debate-caso, and estudo-dirigido (expository lessons on one fictional case with an executable kit, one single-source file per lesson rendered by bundled generators into deck, script, plan, figures, study-guide PDF and monitor, interactive and instructor guides, with real recorded demo runs). Components in commands/, agents/, skills/ and hooks/hooks.json are auto-discovered.
